splitModal.title: Grid Alteration
splitModal.desc: You have changed important data for this class. How do you want the system to apply these changes to the database?
splitModal.newPhaseDesc: Invisibly closes the old class and creates the new one. No past reports or attendance will be lost. Ideal for changing schedules, days, or teachers.
splitModal.startDateLabel: THE NEW CONFIGURATION TAKES EFFECT ON:
splitModal.directFixDesc: Replaces the data directly. Attention: This alters the teacher's name and schedules in the past. Use only if the class was registered incorrectly just now.
splitModal.selectDateAlert: Select the exact date the new configuration takes effect.
